scope: Bounded source facts, not real Engine execution evidence. Exact URLs and hashes permit rechecking.

sources.name: 1.40-era-router
observations: Upgrade request receives HTTP/1.1 101, Connection Upgrade, Upgrade tcp, Docker raw-stream media for TTY. Without upgrade, router emits historical 200 raw response.
Router sends attachment headers before invoking exec process start; later process-start failures may arrive as terminal output. TTY writes raw stdout; non-TTY uses stream framing.
